name: Sentinel Tower
description: A Directorate watch-post: a tall angular sensor spire flanked by two asymmetric mast platforms (deliberately mismatched east/west, not mirrored, so it doesn't read as a stamped-out prefab), a small garrison block, and a paved apron fanning toward the access track, the whole site ringed by a perimeter fence (a line part, not a filled area -- see map-template.schema.json's 'kind'). Distinct silhouette from mech-bunker.json on purpose: tall and narrow instead of low and wide, so a skyline with several of these plus a hangar reads as a real mixed installation rather than one shape copy-pasted around the map. Local +Y is the template's own north (deep site, away from the road); the garrison/apron/entrance face -Y (south), so at rotation=0 the road approaches from the south, matching mech-bunker.json's convention. Roughly 84m x 100m overall including the fence -- noticeably more compact than the bunker, appropriate for a smaller watch-post class structure meant to be sited in numbers rather than as a single centrepiece.
